scope: EK08 partial: actual selected music/SFX/native audio file identity, not complete runtime option/environment or human/native certification
behavior: Extend the existing export guard with one per-export resolved-media registration. Capture chosen paths/content hashes, recheck before publication and include published paths in immutable private provenance. Rebinding changed bytes refuses.

CPU resolves/generates each used SFX once and registers music/SFX before encoding. HF resolves sound files once, registers before copying audio, and uses the pinned file for length and media. Native registers actual generated draft audio material references before publication, preserving the existing native sound selection/volume policy.

Record published path aliases separately from temporary read paths. Readback checks published files without selecting libraries or generating missing builtins. Disabled audio registers an empty dependency set. Packet snapshots remain read-only and do not resolve audio libraries.

edges: Same-size/same-mtime changed or deleted selected music/pop/whoosh is rejected.
Explicit/default music and custom SFX changes during CPU encode preserve old MP4; HF router mutation during render returns500 with old MP4/error diagnostics retained.
Real HF builder registers before audio copy; changing original after copy is caught. Native material audio is captured and later changes invalidate the record.
Actual first-use builtin generation is captured after creation; readback never regenerates deleted audio. Empty and published-stage alias binding and relative-path refusal are covered.
tests.fixture_correction: New Windows expectations use the existing canonical path convention, not raw mixed-case paths; no production identity tolerance was relaxed.
